title: The Soaked Sunflower Stunt
intro: Someone sabotaged the community garden's sunflower contest by swapping the sprinkler timers, and every entry is now a soggy mess.

suspects.name: Ruben
suspects.line: Sprinklers? Never touched one. Ask the hose.

suspects.name: Maya
suspects.line: My hands are clean, see? Mostly clean.

suspects.name: Priya
suspects.line: I was judging the pumpkins all morning.

suspects.name: Lupe
suspects.line: I was napping under the big oak. Honest!

suspects.name: Otis
suspects.line: I only came for the lemonade, I swear.

clues.text: A gardener swears they saw the pumpkin patch crew leaving the gate at dusk, but the timers were already swapped by then, so they are not the culprit.
The lemonade jug sat untouched and full all afternoon, so whoever carried it did not handle the sprinkler controls and is not the culprit.
Green gloves were found dry and tidy on the hose reel, so their wearer was never near the timers and is not the culprit.
Fresh soil crumbs and a smear of dirt on the timer dial suggest the saboteur had muddy hands when they reset it.
